top_candidates.original_title: The Verification Problem (On OpenAI's Erdős Disproof)
top_candidates.generated_headline: A Disproof of Erdős and the Limits of Autoregressive Correctness
top_candidates.summary: OpenAI's latest model successfully refuted a long-standing Erdős conjecture, yet the achievement highlights a deeper systemic risk: the computational cost of verifying an AI's mathematical breakthroughs now vastly outstrips the cost of generating them. As generative volume scales, the bottleneck shifts entirely to human and formal verification, threatening to drown mathematical craft in unverified assertions.

top_candidates.generated_headline: The Boundless Art of the Ultra-Minimalist Demo

Quote: I really thought that a 32 byte demo I saw is the limit of how small the binary can get and still look good... This is hell of a good work.
